function:med_tracker.adoption_fact_hash(.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION med_tracker.adoption_fact_hash(fact shared_schedule_adoption_facts)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 SELECT sha256(convert_to(jsonb_build_array(CASE WHEN fact.person_schedule_id IS NULL THEN 'frozen-departure-v1' ELSE 'live-adoption-v1' END,
  fact.person_schedule_id,fact.source_schedule_id,fact.source_portable_id,fact.person_id,fact.household_id,
  fact.medication_take_id,fact.take_portable_id,fact.original_version_id,fact.client_uuid,
  to_char(fact.taken_at,'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US'),fact.dose_amount,fact.dose_unit,fact.taken_from_medication_id,
  fact.taken_from_location_id,to_char(fact.take_created_at,'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US'),
  to_char(fact.take_updated_at,'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US'))::text,'UTF8'))
$function$

policy:public.medication_takes.sharing_a.using:
(((id)::text = current_setting('med_tracker.sharing_take_id'::text, true)) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (shared_schedule_adoption_facts fact
     JOIN legacy_schedule_prescriptions frozen ON ((frozen.schedule_id = fact.source_schedule_id)))
  WHERE ((fact.medication_take_id = medication_takes.id) AND ((frozen.adopted_person_schedule_id)::text = current_setting('med_tracker.sharing_schedule_id'::text, true))))))

policy:public.shared_schedule_administra.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (shared_schedule_adoption_facts fact
     JOIN legacy_schedule_prescriptions frozen ON ((frozen.schedule_id = fact.source_schedule_id)))
  WHERE ((fact.medication_take_id = shared_schedule_administrations.medication_take_id) AND ((frozen.adopted_person_schedule_id)::text = (shared_schedule_administrations.person_schedule_id)::text) AND med_tracker.sharing_clinical_authority(frozen.person_id))))

policy:public.shared_schedule_administra.check:
((occurrence_starts_on IS NULL) AND (occurrence_position IS NULL) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (shared_schedule_adoption_facts fact
     JOIN legacy_schedule_prescriptions frozen ON ((frozen.schedule_id = fact.source_schedule_id)))
  WHERE ((fact.medication_take_id = shared_schedule_administrations.medication_take_id) AND (fact.household_id = shared_schedule_administrations.household_id) AND (fact.person_schedule_id IS NULL) AND ((frozen.adopted_person_schedule_id)::text = (shared_schedule_administrations.person_schedule_id)::text) AND med_tracker.sharing_clinical_authority(frozen.person_id)))))
